title: Enzo Long - Let You Go
htmlContent:
Fresh to the block artist Enzo Long has recently released a new hit single titled “Let You Go” which was released to the public on Sep 30, 2022. The track features some interesting new vibes we haven’t heard before. 

“Let You Go” is a brilliant sound to life, matched with heartfelt lyrics on this new must-hear artistry that makes you feel like you’re being drawn to the music, as you relate to the experience being provided in every way. 

If you’re looking to feel a master class of music, as well as an artist to connect to, Enzo Long gives you all of that and so much more on this stand-out release of music. “Let You Go” is now available for streaming on all music platforms.
